notes.title: Chumini: Tiny Army | Demo Update 0.4.23
notes.notes:
Hello there!

We’ve just rolled out a fresh update that makes building your tiny army feel smoother, snappier, and even more satisfying. Here's what’s new:


Upgrade UI Improvements
New Icons: Each statistic now has its own shiny icon to help you strategize at a glance.

Smooth Animations: We’ve added sleek transitions and effects to make navigating upgrades feel more dynamic and rewarding.

New "recap" screen: there's now an updated recap screen (that you can access in the pause menu) with live key stats from you current game


Balance Adjustments
Minor tweaks across several upgrades and enemies to keep things fun, fair, and challenging.

This is part of our ongoing mission to polish the core loop and make every run a joy to play. Thanks as always for your support and feedback, keep it coming!



Now go forth and grow that tiny army! ✨

notes.title: Chumini: Tiny Army | Playtest Update 0.1.5
notes.notes:
Hey eveyone! Thank you very much for all the support, kind words and feedback regarding the playtest version of Chumini!  💖 
We just released an update to fix some issues, and to add missing stuff into the game.

Balance:

 Final boss is no longer one-shotable
 Final waves are less difficult, and spawn less projectile-based enemies
 Altruistics, Sads and Lonelies are now slightly nerfed
 There are now 10 levels of difficulty


Bugs & fixes:

 Fixed typos in several Chuminis Upgrade descriptions
 Altruistics freeze duration now scale with the levels as intended


QoL improvements:

 Added a choice to disable screenshakes in the Options menu
 Added a choice to disable chromatic aberration in the Options menu
 Chumini damages in recap screen are now separated in "Contact damage" and "Ability damage" for more clarity


Other:

 Added a different music for the 5 first minutes of playthrough, because the previous one was getting too repetitive
 Added names of peoples who answered the playtest google form in the credits

notes.title: Chumini: Tiny Army | Playtest version is NOW LIVE!
notes.notes:
Help us to figure out what can be improved in our game Chumini: Tiny Army!

Chumini: Tiny Army is a cute & short survivor-like, in which you summon colorful tiny creatures instead of your traditional weapons and spells. You have to survive waves of sylvan demons for 20 minutes!

Features


 A cast of colorful Chuminis to play with!
 Keyboard and controler supported.
 Meta-progression in-between runs to progress further each try.
 Difficulty levels to unlock.
 A passionate team, waiting for your feedbacks! ❤


After playing, you'll be able to fill up a google form in order to give us your feedbacks! If you want to help us and that you have some free time, please consider it! It'll help us a lot!

And have fun! 😊
